screen.description: A full pane that can hold other elements. Config holds chooses what the pane is for (message_exchange for send and receive, arbitrary for anything else). Config selection=conversations shows a chooser among listed conversations.

sidebar.description: A side pane next to a screen. Config holds=messages shows a reply or detail thread. Config visible_when=reply_thread hides it until a parent message is opened.

section.description: Groups related children with visual separation. Config title is an optional heading above the group. Prefer section over inventing layout chrome.

tab_strip.description: A row of tabs. Bind conversations to list rooms, channels, or DMs from result.emit threads.

message_list.description: A scrolling list of message elements. Bind selected_conversation for the open room, or selected_thread for replies to a parent message.

message.description: One message bubble: sender and body. Used inside message_list. Do not invent vendor-specific bubbles.

composer.description: Text input plus send. Bind selected_conversation to post in the open room, or selected_thread to reply to a parent message.

text_field.description: A single-line or multi-line input box. Config placeholder is the empty hint. Config label is an optional caption above the field.

select.description: A drop-down. Bind conversations to pick a room, or pass options in config. Config label is an optional caption.

button.description: A pressable control. Config label is the visible name. Config style is primary or secondary.

text.description: Plain or markdown text. Config style is title, body, callout, or caption.

table.description: Rows and columns for a scanable list.

calendar.description: Pick a calendar date (day/month/year). Config label is an optional caption. Use calendar alone for dates; pair with time in a section when both are needed.

time.description: Pick a time of day. Config label is an optional caption. Use time alone for clock values; pair with calendar in a section when both are needed.
